annotation.title_clean: 上海市浦东新区促进无驾驶人智能网联汽车创新应用规定
annotation.title_en: Regulations of Shanghai Pudong New Area on Promoting Innovative Application of Driverless Intelligent Connected Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 上海市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of Shanghai Municipal People's Congress)
annotation.venue: 浦东新区人民政府 website
annotation.summary_en: Shanghai People's Congress Standing Committee regulation, effective 1 Feb 2023, governing driverless intelligent connected vehicle testing, demonstration and commercial operation in Pudong New Area. It sets a staged safety self-declaration confirmation system, remote monitoring, insurance, data and cybersecurity duties, incident reporting, enterprise-first compensation, and suspension and termination rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Staged safety self-declaration confirmation required for road testing, demonstration application, demonstration operation, before plates are issued
Companies need remote monitoring, emergency takeover personnel, and mandatory traffic and commercial insurance
Accident reporting: upload at least 90 seconds of pre-accident video within two hours; analysis report retained one year
Company compensates first for accidents and may recover from system developers, manufacturers or suppliers
Cybersecurity, data security and in-country storage of important data; suspension or termination for violations; unmanned delivery/cleaning devices treated as non-motor vehicles
